summary: Banzai International filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a follow-on offering of 327,273 shares of Class A common stock at $2.75 per share, raising $900,000 ($837,000 net after 7% underwriting discount). The shares are listed on Nasdaq (BNZI). The offering is a routine equity shelf takedown under its existing S-3 shelf, subject to the one-third public float limitation. Aegis Capital Corp. is sole book-runner. No special-situation catalyst (acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change) is present. Simply an at-the-market capital raise.
